description:
Return durable historical ADDED (ABSENT -> PRESENT) and REMOVED (PRESENT -> ABSENT) customer-domain changes for a vendor in a UTC time window; REMOVED does not prove contract cancellation and ADDED does not prove commercial purchase.
USE WHEN: agent needs durable historical ADDED/REMOVED customer-domain changes for a vendor in a UTC time window.
DO NOT USE WHEN: current confirmed customer base; technologies on one domain; competitor replacement/switch inference.
USE installed-base-intelligence FOR: confirmed customer domains currently known for a technology/vendor.
USE technology-intelligence FOR: technologies detected on a public domain.
USE competitor-switch-intelligence FOR: competitor replacement/switch signals.

vendor.description: Technology/vendor to query confirmed changes for (e.g., klaviyo, yotpo, judge.me).
vendor.title: Vendor

name: change_intelligence

change_count.description: Total confirmed changes for the vendor in the window.

changes.description: Confirmed ADDED/REMOVED changes ordered by changed_at DESC, domain ASC.

changed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the durable transition was observed.

domain.description: Customer domain that experienced a confirmed technology change.

fingerprints.description: Bounded matched fingerprint evidence (ids and types only).

from_state.description: State before the transition (ABSENT or PRESENT).

response_validity.description: Response validity of the confirming observation.

scanner_version.description: Scanner version that produced the observation.

to_state.description: State after the transition (PRESENT or ABSENT).

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp of the query response generation.

title: STRAELO Change Intelligence
